'''2011 Worlds Day 3 Jonny Chu DS Endor Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Jonny Chu]] at [[2011 World Championship]] (Day 3).

Deck name '''Dan Kim Revival'''.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Endor Operations / Imperial Outpost|Endor Operations]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.3]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 3
